parent.title: The next step, with the evidence behind it
parent.intro: Move from the next lesson to the wider learning story without losing sight of messages, consent, or charges that need attention.
parent.workspaceIntro: Each panel opens the module that owns the record. Progress is described from completed work, feedback, and milestones.

studentYounger.title: Ready for your next step?
studentYounger.intro: See what is happening next, finish today’s work, and follow the path you have already made.
studentYounger.workspaceIntro: Big, simple choices keep lessons, tasks, progress, and help easy to find.

studentOlder.title: Plan the work. See the evidence.
studentOlder.personalTitle: {name}, plan the work and see the evidence
studentOlder.intro: A detailed view of your calendar, learning plan, feedback, projects, and the records that show how your work is changing.
studentOlder.workspaceIntro: Use the detailed module surfaces for planning, practice, reflection, and evidence-backed progress analytics.

tutor.title: Teach the lesson. Close the loop.
tutor.intro: Today’s teaching load, the work waiting after each lesson, and the student records that need a thoughtful next action.
tutor.workspaceIntro: Student records remain relationship-scoped; finance stays limited to your own earnings summary.

admin.title: See the system. Work the queue.
admin.intro: Service health, learning delivery, and the queues where a timely decision keeps students, families, and tutors moving.
admin.workspaceIntro: High-risk actions remain behind fresh step-up authentication and second-person approval.

finance.title: Settle, reconcile, account.
finance.intro: Revenue, payment exceptions, tutor liabilities, and payout evidence in a workspace that contains no academic records.
finance.workspaceIntro: Amounts remain currency-explicit and every refund or payout action stays in its owning finance module.
